---
title: "Projects"
description: "Search, filter, sort, and review engineering project evidence."
page-layout: full
listing:
  contents: "*.qmd"
  type: grid
  grid-columns: 2
  sort: "date desc"
  sort-ui: [date, title]
  filter-ui: [title, description, categories]
  categories: true
  fields: [image, title, description, date, categories]
  page-size: 12
---

Use the filter box, category list, or sort control to find a project. Add a new `.qmd` file in this folder; Quarto will include it when its metadata is valid.
